name: Bundle of Crocolisk Skins
summary: Hunters in the Wetlands send crocolisk skins west to Menethil Harbor. There, leatherworkers put the hides to use.

sections.title: Wetlands Commerce and Domestic Strife
sections.body: In the Wetlands, hunters gather and cure tough, water-resistant crocolisk skins for Menethil Harbor. James Halloran is among the artisans who receive them. Einar has gathered this bundle, but asks a traveler to carry it into town. He hopes to avoid going home to face the temper of his frustrated wife, Sida.

faq.q: What is the Bundle of Crocolisk Skins used for?
faq.answer: James Halloran, a tanner in Menethil Harbor, receives the bundle's raw and cured marsh hides. He makes sturdy boots, belts, and leather armor suited to the Wetlands' damp, flooded ground.

Hunter Einar gathered and bundled the skins in the marshes. He usually carries his trade goods into town himself, but asks a passing traveler to bring this bundle so he can avoid an argument with his wife, Sida.

James Halloran works as a leatherworker and tanner in Menethil Harbor. He buys raw and cured hides from marsh hunters and makes boots, cured leather, and practical gear for sailors, soldiers, and townspeople.

angles.text: As an Alliance traveler, you can see how hunters beyond Menethil Harbor supply materials for its garrison and citizens in the harsh swamp.
